about.heading: About
about.bio: I'm Putria, from Kebumen. At SMA Muhammadiyah Gombong I coordinated a leadership camp, edited a science textbook, led a team developing shampoo from watermelon rind waste, and served as treasurer of a student organization. My skills are public speaking and editing.
about.languagesValue: Javanese (native), English (reading B2; listening, speaking, writing B1)
about.educationValue: SMA Muhammadiyah Gombong, 2023–2026, natural sciences and mathematics
